themes.label: Cinema title sequences
themes.triviaNote: A title treatment can suggest a genre, period or mood before the story begins. Designers use type proportions, contrast and spacing as part of the visual world-building.

themes.label: Poster culture
themes.triviaTitle: Posters are read at a glance
themes.triviaNote: A poster has to establish hierarchy at a distance. A strong typeface gives the title a memorable silhouette while weight and spacing help the message survive a quick look.
